name: mathem-cli
description: Unofficial automation-first CLI for Mathem Sweden.
author: onmax

scripts.release: test "$(git branch --show-current)" = main && git fetch origin main && test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" && release_tag=$(npm version patch -m "chore: release v%s") && git push --atomic origin main "$release_tag"
